objective: NEST-COUNT-20261112-001 direction 1 (counting inside), at the owner's go-ahead of 2026-11-12 ('Yes, let's continue on with that.') (G17, with G1): an exact method for the least bond between a top distinction and one at depth s along one ray of copies of a nested NAE family (a DP over blocks with families of reachable interface-state sets), validated against brute force and on chains with no cycle of knots, and a first reading on the 664 one-definition families alive only in the usual limit: is the least ray bond bounded or growing with depth, and at what exact eventual rate. Standalone value relative to the nearest known work: bonds are minimal non-shattered sets (Sauer-Shelah, Pajor) and bounded-treewidth 2-QBF DPs are known in kind; the growth of least bonds with depth in nested NAE patterns was not found.
status: Complete 2026-11-13 (Partially successful; referee pending): an exact ray DP for least bonds across depths (validated); in 204 of 664 one-definition limit-only families the reach is exactly bounded, in 240 it grows steadily within depth 30 (one member per one to three levels), none proved growing.
